note: The turtle island in the middle of the lake: Turtle Tower (HoanKiemMap.defend_model) stands at its centre on the 28 x 28 m lawn grid. island is a smooth union of lobes [cx, cz, rx, rz] shaped like a turtle seen from above (shell, head to the north, tail, four flippers), edged with boulders, not paved. lawn and carpet are the ellipse GrassMultiMesh treats as island ground; tree_clear keeps scattered trees off the lawn grid.
